items.note: The cream header band is short now (about 220px): eyebrow, h2 title and one line, with a small ID-card cluster on the right. Below it is a cream 24px form panel with a yellow crescent-shaded avatar disc, warm-grey bordered fields and ink/cream pills, so it reads like the reference's form panel (09). The band-height gap from rc.4 is closed. The bio field runs past the fold, so the ink save pill sits just below the first desktop screen.

The compact cream band has its arc and the cluster tucked about 96px into the top corner, as on the reference phone (04). It stays well under one screen and the form panel starts at once. Fields, the avatar disc and the full-width ink save pill keep the reference's rounded, warm craft.

The night version has a navy page, an indigo header band with a wave edge and an indigo form panel with lighter indigo fields. It follows the reference's night palette (03) closely, and the yellow avatar and card cluster give it the same warm accents. Hierarchy and spacing match the light version.

The phone night layout is well built: indigo band with the corner cluster, indigo panel, white save pill and indigo reset pill, all in the reference's night language. The page still ends in a bright white bottom bar under the indigo footer, the only light surface on the page.

The compact cream band has a tally chip and a well-composed bell cluster (bell, yellow disc, pink four-point star, cloud). Below it, cream group panels have spot plates by each title and 1px-ruled rows with switches, which gets close to the reference's ruled rows and plates (07, 12). The on switches are crisp ink, but the off switches are warm grey on cream and nearly vanish.

On the phone the band stays compact with the bell cluster in the corner, and the plate-headed panel and ruled switch rows keep good rhythm at 16–20px type. The faint off switch from desktop repeats here, but the hierarchy and spacing match the reference phone.

The indigo band with the bell scene and indigo panels with dark spot plates read as the reference's night palette. At night the off switch is a visible indigo track with a white knob and the on switch is white, so the states are clearer than in light mode.

The phone night layout matches the reference's dark language: a compact indigo band with its arc, a dark plate by the group title, ruled rows and white/indigo switches that are easy to read. Spacing is even and the type sizes are generous.

The compact cream band carries a padlock cluster: a green crescent-shaded lock cutting into a violet disc, a yellow star and a cloud. It is a clear one-noun subject in the reference's flat kit. The cream panel has a key spot plate, reading-width fields and an ink update pill, all in the first viewport.

The phone keeps the band compact with the lock cluster in the corner. The password panel with its key plate and full-width ink pill sits in the first screen. Further down, the sessions table is a clean bordered frame, close to the reference's restrained rows (05).

The night palette is applied cleanly: indigo band and panel, lighter indigo fields with lavender borders and a white primary pill, as in the reference's night band (03). The lock cluster holds its saturated hues against the indigo.
The phone night version has a compact indigo band, a key plate on a dark disc, roomy fields and a full-width white pill. Hierarchy is clear and the screen is consistent with the other night screens.

The cream band has a wallet cluster. The plans panel puts white option cards around a saturated orange current-plan card with big bold prices, green ticks and ink pills, which carries the language as well as the reference's color stat tiles (08). The payment and invoice panels below use spot plates and a quiet bordered table.

On the phone the plan cards stack in one column, with the orange current plan as the one saturated field, and the band stays compact. The plates, the bold 40px+ prices and the full-width rhythm keep the reference's warmth. The invoice table scrolls in its frame.

At night the plan cards are indigo with white pills, and the orange current plan stays saturated with ink text and an indigo chip. This is a convincing take on the reference's night palette, and the hierarchy of the three plans is as clear as in light mode.

The stacked plan cards, the indigo panels with dark plates and the invoice table read as the same night system as the reference. As on the other dark pages, the white bottom bar under the indigo footer breaks the dark-to-the-edge finish.

findings.summary: In dark mode, the footer still ends in a bright white bottom bar under the indigo footer band. It is the only light surface on a night page, while the reference's night palette stays dark to the edge (03). This was named in rc.3 and rc.4 and has not closed, because the spec still assigns `surface.inverse` (white at night) to that bar.
findings.promptFix: Give the footer bottom bar its own role token: the darkest surface in each appearance, ink by day and a step darker than the navy page at night, with white text in both. Keep `surface.inverse` for small floating pieces such as toasts.
findings.specRule: Footer | Cream band with rise arc, link columns, a signup field + ink pill; `surface.inverse` bottom bar with round icon buttons … (dark) `color.surface.inverse` | `#ffffff`

findings.summary: In light mode, an off switch is a warm-grey track one step from the cream group panel, so it nearly disappears next to the crisp ink on switches. The reference designs every control state to read at a glance (09, 11). This carries over from rc.4. The night version is clear.

On the desktop profile form, the bio field pushes the ink save pill just below the first screen, though the spec puts a form's primary action in the first desktop viewport. The band itself is now compact, so the agent missed this; the spec didn't cause it.
